Hi Soojin,

We signed up a couple of weeks ago and our ingest has jumped this morning — looks like we pushed a new batch of transcripts and token usage spiked. First off, Redwood is shipping; nice work.

We'd love a short 15–20 minute walkthrough to make sure we're getting the most cost-effective serving config (batching/kv cache, model variant suggestions). Would you or someone on the SDR/ops side be available for a quick technical check-in today or tomorrow?

Prefer ET afternoon. I'm including Priya (engineering) on the thread — she'd likely join.

Thanks,

Hi Alex — great to hear and congrats on the ramp. Quick note: a short ops check-in is exactly the right move so we can point you at low-friction wins. I can run this myself or loop Jordan (solutions eng) if you want a deeper dive.

Goals I typically aim for in 20 minutes:
- Confirm workload pattern (seq lengths, burstiness)
- Suggested batching & KV/caching config
- One tactical setting to lower per-token cost without hurting latency

I have these windows (all PT):
- Today 4:00–4:20pm PT / 7:00–7:20pm ET
- Tomorrow 9:00–9:20am PT / 12:00–12:20pm ET
- Tomorrow 11:30–11:50am PT / 2:30–2:50pm ET
- Tomorrow 2:00–2:20pm PT / 5:00–5:20pm ET
- Tue 8:30–8:50am PT / 11:30–11:50am ET

If none of those work, tell me a couple of ET slots that do and I'll propose alternatives.

I've attached a one-pager agenda and a short runbook we often walk through. Calendar link: https://cal.com/soojin-lee/20min (pick a slot and it books my calendar).

Thanks — talk soon.

— Soojin
Soojín Lee | SDR, Redwood Inference
